notes.discrepancy: Fold means (0.507/0.746) from the faithful fixed-architecture run (VIJAY, 2026-10-04). These are the values displayed in the manuscript. Pooled OOF values are 0.484/0.736 (endpoint_results.csv). Supersedes the ab_c_full-based paired test (0.527/0.751, diff 0.249/0.160), which used a non-faithful configuration.

notes.folds_paired: Paired by fold number on identical test splits.
